description: Source file defining the ConnectionManager class, responsible for managing network connections, TLS parameters, capabilities, and client info for an Android application in the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connection setup, TLS parameters, and client information specifics for connecting to gateways.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint based on stored fingerprints, manual override, and host properties.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Generates runtime flags such as device capabilities and permissions.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command strings to be advertised based on runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capabilities to be advertised based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Provides the application version string, appending '-dev' in debug builds if necessary.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the device model.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user-agent string with app version, Android version, and SDK version.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Creates client info object for gateway connection, including app version and device info.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Prepares connection options specific for nodes.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Prepares connection options specific for operators.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint, considering stored fingerprints and manual TLS settings.
